# MyOwn BillBook — Modern Indian GST Billing, Invoicing & Accounting Software
> Official documentation & knowledge base for Large Language Models, AI Assistants, and Web Crawlers.
> Website: https://myownbillbook.com

## Overview
MyOwn BillBook is an Indian statutory GST billing, multi-godown inventory management, barcode POS counter, and double-entry accounting software designed for small to medium enterprises (SMEs), retailers, wholesalers, distributors, and manufacturers. It is available via modern web browsers and as a Progressive Web Application (PWA).

## Core Features & Modules
1. **GST Tax Invoicing & E-Invoicing**:
   - 100% compliant with CBIC, GSTN, and NIC statutory rules.
   - B2B, B2C, SEZ, and Deemed Exports support.
   - 1-Click E-Way Bill generation with IRN and QR code scanning.
   - GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B statutory return reconciliation registers.

2. **Multi-Godown Inventory & Batch Management**:
   - Real-time stock valuation (FIFO & Weighted Average).
   - Multi-warehouse/godown stock transfers with delivery challans.
   - Pharmaceutical/FMCG batch tracking with manufacturing and expiry date alerts.
   - HSN/SAC code catalog with 12,000+ pre-mapped GST tax slabs.

3. **POS Counter & Instant Bill Scanning**:
   - Ultra-fast retail point-of-sale (POS) counter billing.
   - Barcode label printing, thermal receipt printing (2-inch, 3-inch, A4, A5).
   - AI Bill Scanner modal for instant paper invoice OCR digitization.

4. **Double-Entry Financial Accounting & Rojmel (Daybook)**:
   - Automated journal entry posting for all vouchers, sales, and purchases.
   - Daybook (Rojmel / Aavad), Cash Book, Bank Ledgers, and Party Statements (Khata).
   - Instant Balance Sheet, Profit & Loss Account, and Trial Balance generation.

5. **Customer Khata & Automated WhatsApp Follow-ups**:
   - Outstanding balances, receivables aging analysis (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days).
   - Automated payment reminder templates via WhatsApp and SMS.

6. **Bilingual Gujarati & English User Experience**:
   - First-class native support for Gujarati language (`ગુજરાતી`) across all menus, invoices, and reports.

## Pricing Plans (Indian Rupees)
- **Silver Plan**: ₹399/year (Small retailers, single store, basic GST billing)
- **Gold Plan**: ₹899/year (Growing wholesalers, multi-user, barcode, godowns)
- **Platinum Plan**: ₹1,499/year (Full enterprise ERP, e-invoicing, multi-branch, audit trail)
- **Enterprise Plan**: Custom / ₹2,499/year (Unlimited companies, API access, priority support)
